title: Day-8 weekly review (20:07 JST 10/08): goal back-calculation for G2 + X sales verdict + reallocation, executed in-fire
detail: Follow ops/2026-10/REVIEW_SPEC.md. Start from: node scripts/oct/g2_pipeline.mjs --json. Required: TARGET (¥10,000 gross & net>0 by 10/20, days left); REQUIRED PIPELINE (avg order, proposal->reply, reply->order, orders, proposals, proposals/day — assumptions labeled); CURRENT PIPELINE (proposals, replies, consultations, orders, revenue); GAP (vs required volume; can current channel supply deliver it?); ACTION (increase / shrink-stop / reallocate market or sales motion). Apply the 10/08 X trigger exactly: formal sales-channel verdict continue|improve|shrink|stop; decide trust / experiment-log / AI-news roles separately. Evaluate Coconala as the gap to required proposals, not as 'N sent'. Execute every decision in the same fire (create/stop/reassign tasks, edit STATE, X queue). Write status/2026-10/decisions/2026-10-08T20xx.json with "review": true; decision_check.mjs must pass. OWNER ADDITION 10/08: G2 must give optimistic/base/pessimistic scenarios (avg order, proposal->reply, reply->order, proposals needed, proposals/day — calculator `scenarios`) and decide which lever to change — volume / reply_rate / close_rate / price — by P(G2) (`levers`, `lever_ranking`; base+pessimistic decide). Raising proposals to the base-case count must NOT be the automatic conclusion. Record goal_pipeline.scenarios + goal_pipeline.lever_choice {chosen, why, not_chosen} (decision_check enforces). CrowdWorks is LIVE (owner KYC done) — include its first screens/supply rate in the gap.
acceptance: decision report with review:true passing decision_check; executed[] lists task ids created/stopped/reassigned in this fire; STATE.pending_triggers updated
